snippet.title: You Are Vanguard | The Most Brutal Extraction Shooter
snippet.description:
EVE Vanguard is an extraction-adventure FPS set in the EVE Online universe, where you play as a Vanguard, an elite mercenary fused with ancient technology whose immortal consciousness drives the tides of war, deploying to hostile planets across New Eden to raid crash sites, assault forward operating bases, secure exotic technology, gather resources, and extract before colossal Nemesis drones descend to hunt you down, all while shaping the player-driven conflicts of New Eden.

💬 Drop your questions or feedback below. The dev team reads the comments and your input helps shape EVE Vanguard’s future.


Wishlist EVE Vanguard on Steam today:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1872800

Discord - https://discord.gg/evevanguard
